--- pipe_aggregate_trailing_comma_before_pipe.sql
FROM Sales
|> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n,
|> WHERE n > 0

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 10,
            Name:    "Sales",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeAggregate{
        Pipe:  11,
        Items: []*ast.PipeAggregateItem{
          &ast.PipeAggregateItem{
            DirPos: -1,
            Expr:   &ast.CountStarExpr{
              Count:  24,
              Rparen: 31,
            },
            As: &ast.AsAlias{
              As:    33,
              Alias: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 36,
                NameEnd: 37,
                Name:    "n",
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      &ast.PipeWhere{
        Pipe: 39,
        Expr: &ast.BinaryExpr{
          Op:   ">",
          Left: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 48,
            NameEnd: 49,
            Name:    "n",
          },
          Right: &ast.IntLiteral{
            ValuePos: 52,
            ValueEnd: 53,
            Base:     10,
            Value:    "0",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM Sales |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n |> WHERE n > 0
